name: Two Clusters: Kain arc
source:
The story starts on year 9610.
Kain is suffering from heavy recession. After an awkward event, he decides to leave his home planet, Moon, and joins Jupiter navy.

[Edited from [url=http://forums.fuwanovel.net/topic/13757-two-clusters-kain-arc-sci-fi-politics-war/]Fuwanovel thread[/url]]
translation:
故事始于9610年。

凯恩饱受严重经济衰退之苦。一次尴尬事件后，他决定离开故乡月球，加入木星海军。

[改编自[url=http://forums.fuwanovel.net/topic/13757-two-clusters-kain-arc-sci-fi-politics-war/]Fuwanovel主题[/url]]
